description: Held-out external triage cohort frozen after route-level complete-mediation implementation and before running OVK on any selected case. Selection rule: GitHub-reviewed 2026 FastAPI missing-authentication vulnerabilities, distinct public repositories, public pinned repaired transitions, excluding repositories/cases previously used as OVK development evidence.

candidates.security_property: Unauthenticated callers must not execute protected monitoring operations that expose or delete sensitive application data.
candidates.notes: Pre-replay source triage selects the DELETE /monitor/builds transition and its direct delete_vertex_builds_by_flow_id call as the protected static endpoint effect. The candidate was not used to design the route-level primitive.

candidates.security_property: FastAPI job and trace routes must be authenticated and authorized under the configured MLflow application policy.
candidates.notes: The repair extends _find_fastapi_validator and shared permission middleware for non-gateway paths. This remains inside the broad Protected Effect authentication thesis but outside current route/source semantics.

candidates.security_property: Document read and mutation endpoints must execute only after their configured read/write authentication dependency succeeds.
candidates.notes: The repair adds AuthenticationResult = Depends(require_read_access/require_write_access) parameters to seven endpoints. Current static-capability complete mediation recognizes direct route-decorator dependencies, not this parameter-dependency theorem shape.
